models.name: Ornith 1.5 35B A3B
models.score_source: ESTIMATE (no AA data as of 2026-11-06): vendor Terminal-Bench 2.1 is 67.8 (Terminus-2) vs 52.5 for Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on the same harness; scaling through AA's measured 44.9 for Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (catalog 9.5) and the Qwen3.6-27B (60.7, 12.0) and Qwen3.8-27B (79.8, 20.1) points gives 12 to 14. Vendor GPQA Diamond 89.2 and HLE 25.6 support it. Treat as UNVERIFIED.
models.notes: Released 2026-08-18 by Ornith AI. 35B total, about 3B active, Qwen3.5-MoE backbone with linear attention in 30 of 40 layers, so only 10 layers carry a growing KV cache. Vendor numbers, five-run averages: Terminal-Bench 2.1 67.8 (Terminus-2) and 68.5 (Claude Code), SWE-bench Verified 79.0, SWE-bench Pro 59.6, GPQA Diamond 89.2, HLE 25.6, NL2Repo 46.2. Q3_K_XL (17.8 GB) fits 24 GB with 64K context and q8 KV; 256K context still fits a Linux budget. The image projector is a separate mmproj file. Not on Artificial Analysis on 2026-11-06.

models.name: Groot 19B A3B
models.score_source: ESTIMATE (no AA data as of 2026-11-06): vendor 16-benchmark average is 41.44 vs 38.08 for Qwen3.6-35B-A3B and 30.05 for Gemma-4-26B-A4B; Terminal-Bench 2.1 is 52.10 vs 43.82 and LongBench v2 is 62.03 vs 48.12. That is 8.8% above the catalog's 9.5 for Qwen3.6-35B-A3B; 19B total limits knowledge capacity, so 10.0. Treat as UNVERIFIED.
models.notes: Released 2026-10-23 by the Groot Team, post-trained from Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on under 0.1B tokens. 19B total, about 3B active, 10 full-attention layers with linear attention elsewhere. Vendor numbers: 16-benchmark average 41.44, Terminal-Bench 2.1 52.10, NL2Repo 35.65, LongBench v2 62.03. Q8_0 (20.2 GB) fits 24 GB with 64K context, so this tier can run a near-lossless quant; the vendor claims 256K on a 24 GB RTX 4090. The image projector is a separate mmproj file. Not on Artificial Analysis on 2026-11-06.

models.name: Flint 40B A2.5B
models.score_source: ESTIMATE (no AA data as of 2026-11-06): coding-agent specialist; vendor Terminal-Bench 2.1 is 54.9 (Terminus 2), SWE-bench Verified 74.2 and SWE-bench Pro v2 89.7. Qwen3.6-35B-A3B measures 44.9 on AA's Terminal-Bench 2.1 and scores 9.5 here, so 54.9 maps near 10.5; general knowledge is untested. Treat as UNVERIFIED.
models.notes: Released 2026-10 by Recursive Superintelligence for coding agents. 39.8B total, about 2.5B active, 49 layers: 14 full-attention plus 35 sliding-window layers (window 513), so long context is cheap. Vendor numbers, with web-retrieved solutions counted as failures: Terminal-Bench 2.1 54.9, SWE-bench Pro v2 89.7, SWE-bench Verified 74.2. UD-Q3_K_XL (18.5 GB) fits 24 GB with 64K context; UD-Q4_K_XL (25.1 GB) does not. Coding-focused, so general chat and knowledge are unproven. Not on Artificial Analysis on 2026-11-06.

models.name: LFM2.5 24B A2B
models.score_source: ESTIMATE (no AA data as of 2026-11-06): vendor LiveClaw is 48.09 vs 38.19 for Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, so agentic tasks sit slightly above the catalog's 9.5 for Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, but 2B active parameters limit knowledge and reasoning, hence 7.5. Treat as UNVERIFIED.
models.notes: Released 2026-10-09 by Liquid AI. 24B total, about 2B active, 40 layers: 10 full-attention and 30 short-convolution layers, so the KV cache is small and speed is high. Vendor: LiveClaw 48.09 vs 38.19 for Qwen3.6-35B-A3B; Liquid claims 184 tok/s on an Apple M5 Max. UD-Q5_K_XL (17.9 GB) fits 24 GB with 64K context; UD-Q6_K_XL (21.9 GB) is tight on Windows.
